jp:
<STBG 11,1><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 5><NAME 9><CHAR 5,5,8,5,0><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CV 2,4>I'm back, nya!
It was a fun gathering, nya~
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,2><CV 1,90>Argo, where had you gone?
<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,15><CHAR 5,0,8,7,0>I don't really get it, nya!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,1><CHAR 5,0,8,4,0>I got lost on the island,
and ended up somewhere strange, nya!

<CV 2,5><CHAR 5,0,8,5,4>There were cute plush-like folk
who said 「kupo」, nya.

<CV 2,7><CHAR 5,0,8,5,3>Good folk, they were, nya.
We talked all night about the
woes of being a mascot, nya!

<CHAR 5,0,8,7,0><CV 2,15>And since we hit it off,
I had them come, nya!
Look over there, nya!
<BGM 1,0,503><STBG 11,3><CHAR 5,0,8,4,0><MWT 3>Gwooooooooh
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,74>Um, that monster is...

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,2><CHAR 5,0,8,4,7>Nya nya, no, that's wrong, nya!
I didn't call that one, nya!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,5,5,0,0><CV 3,21><BGM 0,500,505>Big trouble!
A monster I've never seen suddenly...!
<CV 3,43><CHAR 5,0,5,0,5>Wah, here too...

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CHAR 5,7,8,4,0><CV 2,10>Nya nya, I get it, nya!
It's that thing called
「the terrifying monster-kupo」, nya!

<CHAR 5,0,8,6,0><CV 2,6>This is bad, nya!
If it comes out onto the island,
it'll be terrible, nya!
<CHAR 5,0,8,4,1><CV 2,2>We have to slay it, nya!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,11><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>...Understood.
Let's go!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><ITEM AD_BODY526,1,1><CV 2,7>They said 「amazing gear drops, kupo!」,
nya.
<TALK 1><NAME 1>Amazing gear...?

<TALK 5><NAME 9><ITEM AD_BODY527,1,1><CV 2,1>Nya! It can evolve, and
<COL C70101FF>it shows special power
against that monster</COL> — top-notch, nya!

<ITEM WD_LSWORD203,1,1><CV 2,5>And they said 「there's legendary gear
like this too, kupo!」, nya!

<CHAR 5,0,8,6,0><CV 2,6>This time it's my fault, so I'll ask
a Nyan Search acquaintance
to look for that gear, nya!

<CHAR 5,0,8,7,0><CV 2,8><ITEM 0,1,0>I hear it's a scary monster
that rains down fire, nya!
Be careful hunting it, nya!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,7>Yes!
Understood!
<CLS>
